purpose: Teach: 変質/崇高/安堵/慰謝/感知/講ずる/発病/成就

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員のメンタルが変質する前に支援しろ
lines.en: Support our staff before mental strain takes root.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Slight pause between clauses. Each directive lands with weight. No softening — this is a command dressed as strategy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。崇高な企業理念を社員に伝えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure our team understands the values that drive us.
lines.style: Respectful but measured. Not overly formal — professional clarity. Direct eye contact. A promise that lands without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業績好調で社員に安堵感を伝えろ
lines.en: Make sure our strong performance translates into confidence for the team.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful delivery. Slight emphasis on 'strong' — this is good news meant to land. Brief pause after 'performance' to let it settle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労災時の慰謝対応を見直しております
lines.en: Yes. We're currently reviewing our compensation procedures for workplace injuries.
lines.style: Professional update. Steady, informative tone. A slight lift at the end — demonstrating forward momentum without self-congratulation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場の変化を感知する仕組みを作れ
lines.en: Build the systems to sense shifts in the market before they hit us.
lines.style: Crisp and demanding. Each phrase distinct. Leans forward slightly on 'before' — anticipation matters. No room for hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。危機管理の対策を講ずる体制を整えました
lines.en: Yes. We've established protocols to handle potential crises quickly.
lines.style: Assured, factual. Controlled pace. The tone of someone who has thought this through. A steady nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の発病を予防する健康管理を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our health and wellness programs to prevent illness from taking hold.
lines.style: Direct, health-focused. Slight warmth underneath the authority — this is about care as much as management. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の市場成就を目指します
lines.en: Yes. We're committed to making our new product launch a market success.
lines.style: Forward-looking, energized without losing professionalism. Slight emphasis on 'committed' — this is where focus lands. A closing note of conviction.
